Updated `src/solution.py` to:
- Accept three-letter weekday names and return no weekend slots.
- Allow any positive integer meeting duration.
- Remove mandatory lunch breaks and post-event buffers.

Preserved conflict checking, chronological results, and the existing 15-minute suggestion cadence. All checks passed.
